discovery: Practical long-distance quantum communication: decoy-state quantum key distribution and satellite-based entanglement distribution and teleportation

nominees.name: Jian-Wei Pan
nominees.affiliation: University of Science and Technology of China, Hefei

motivation: Quantum entanglement was recognised in 2022 as a foundational resource. The nominees turned it into a working technology at global scale. Hoi-Kwong Lo invented the decoy-state method (2005) and measurement-device-independent QKD (2012), which closed the security gap between ideal theory and real, imperfect photon sources and detectors. Jian-Wei Pan pioneered multiphoton entanglement and teleportation, and led the experimental programme that realised these protocols over unprecedented distances. This culminated in the Micius satellite: entanglement distribution over 1200 km, ground-to-satellite quantum teleportation, and intercontinental quantum-secured communication (2017). Together with field networks spanning thousands of kilometres, these experiments tested quantum nonlocality and teleportation at the largest scales ever achieved, and they set up quantum networks as a new physical infrastructure. Their combined work defines how quantum states of light can be controlled and transmitted across the planet.
